title: Brevity Run Index Archive Record v1
description: Planned additive archive/summary record for future .brevity\runs.jsonl compaction. This schema does not imply that mutating compaction exists.

recordType.description: Discriminator for mixed JSON Lines streams.

slug.description: Task slug whose older run records are summarized.

archivedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the archive summary was created.

preservedRunCount.description: Number of raw run records represented by this archive summary.

successCount.description: Number of summarized runs with successful worker status.

failureCount.description: Number of summarized runs with failed worker status or non-zero exit code.

staleCount.description: Number of summarized runs marked stale.

incompleteCount.description: Number of summarized runs marked incomplete.

archivedRunIds.description: Explicit run IDs represented by this archive summary.

archivedRunRanges.description: Compact run ID ranges represented by this archive summary when ordering is stable and unambiguous.

runBoundary.description: Small summary of an archived run boundary.
